instruction.name: vreplgr2vr.h
instruction.description: Broadcast the low 16 bits of `val` to all lanes of `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move

latencies.notes: 4 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.h $vr1, $r5; vreplgr2vr.h $vr2, $r6; vreplgr2vr.h $vr3, $r7; vreplgr2vr.h $vr4, $r8; vreplgr2vr.h $vr5, $r9; vreplgr2vr.h $vr6, $r10; vreplgr2vr.h $vr7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.h $vr1, $r5; vreplgr2vr.h $vr2, $r6; vreplgr2vr.h $vr3, $r7; vreplgr2vr.h $vr4, $r8; vreplgr2vr.h $vr5, $r9; vreplgr2vr.h $vr6, $r10; vreplgr2vr.h $vr7, $r11'
